span.label: method
span.quote: In this paper, we present a novel method for applying word embedding models to the sociological analysis of culture.

span.label: cultural dimensions in word-embedding spaces
span.quote: We demonstrate that derived dimensions of word embedding vector spaces correspond closely to “cultural dimensions,” such as race, class, and gender, which individuals use in everyday life to classify and categorize objects in the world.

span.label: system-or-tool-building
span.quote: We demonstrate the utility of a new methodological tool, neural-network word embedding models, for large-scale text analysis, revealing how these models produce richer insights into cultural associations and categories than possible with prior methods.
